instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium close-up at eye-level. Inside a bright judo dojo with blue wall padding, the young man in the white gi (R2) on the left grapples closely with the man with short stubble in the white gi (R4) on the right. R2 faces right with a focused, downward gaze, wrapping his right arm over R4's shoulder and gripping his collar. R4 faces left, holding R2's sleeve in a defensive judo stance as they practice. Bright natural light streams from the background windows, casting soft shadows across their white uniforms and creating a shallow depth of field.

R4 holds R2's sleeve in a defensive judo stance
